name: Hiilidioksidivero on diesel oil
law: Laki nestemäisten polttoaineiden valmisteverosta (1472/1994), liite (tax table): the hiilidioksidivero (carbon dioxide tax) on diesel oil, product group 50, 19.78 cents per litre from 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, as Verohallinto's tax tables give it. The excise warehouse keeper pays it on the fuel it releases and passes it on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. This is the rate for fossil diesel oil; blends with renewable diesel pay less. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).

sources.title: Verohallinto: Nestemäisten polttoaineiden verotaulukot, the liquid fuel excise tax tables by period (energy content tax, carbon dioxide tax and security of supply fee per product group)
